column1: # H16 unmarked-line read (Opus vision subagent, 27 Sept 2026, one call, images/f61sheetB_L02/L04/L06/L09/L10.jpg with scripts/f61_atlas.tsv only; no letters, no key). Rows verbatim; its per-sheet lines, verbatim:
# L02: 3 signs in 1 run; before run 1: (start of line, no handwriting before it); after run 1: particulierement sur les
# L04: 1 signs in 1 run; before run 1: beaucoup desiree / desirer; after run 1: Mais on avoit

# L06: 0 signs in 0 runs; the whole line is handwriting ("en connoyssant le fruit ... fesions la premiere point On ne desiroit point du reste"); the barred stroke at the top of segment 1 is the foot of L04's LOOPBAR, which reaches down from the line above, and is not counted

# L09: 0 signs in 0 runs; the whole line is handwriting ("sur les lieux vous verres s'il s'y presentoit les occasions Et s'il s'y pouvoit"); the E at the right edge of segment 3 is the handwritten "Et", not EBR
# L10: 13 signs in 1 run; before run 1: pas paresseux si (the long slash after "si" is taken as the handwritten descender of that word, not a sign); after run 1: nothing, the run ends the line

column8: ll-shaped pair of stems at line start; could be handwritten "Il", coded as cipher because the next two signs follow at once with no word space
two small loops on a long descending stem, clearly phi-like
two short vertical stems joined by a heavy top bar and a heavy bottom bar, like Roman numeral II; no loop, no 4, no triangle (nearest is 4PI, but it is not 4 over pi)
single small loop on a long stem, with a double horizontal bar across the foot (two strokes, the lower one longer and extending left); stands alone between words
square bracket open to the right with top, middle and bottom horizontals (squared E)
loops on a long slanted stem
closed down-pointing triangle under a top bar; no second bar
cut at the seg3/seg4 boundary (left part near seg3 x~2420), counted once; loop on a stem with a second loop to the right ("qo"-like), phi-like
down-pointing triangle with a top bar and a second horizontal bar across its bottom point
figure-8 or infinity lying on a long horizontal bar
loop plus a second loop to the right on a thick long stem ("qo"-like), the same form as pos 6; could be DBL-like but the loops sit side by side, not one above the other
digit-6 shape, heavy ink; last sign on the line
